channel.title: Pier & Point · Historic Building 12
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Historic Building 12 (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Historic Building 12: Building 12 is described as about 248 by 242 feet, not square
item.description: Building 12 is described as about 248 by 242 feet, not square. SFist reported Standard Deviant's taproom open on June 6, 2025, and the SF Standard reported it open on June 25. The October 2022 squash tournament is dated by the report that mentions it, not by the event. The contractor's own page gives both 220,000 and 230,000 square feet. No source read shows whether the Port's 66-year Building 12 lease has been executed. Source: https://sfist.com/2025/06/06/this-week-in-food-mid-spring-debuts/ ; https://sfstandard.com/2025/06/25/standard-deviant-brewing-pier-70-mission-kolsch/ ; https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf ; https://www.rdh.com/our-case-studies/pier-70/ ; https://plantconstruction.com/projects/pier-70-building-12/ ; https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2022/10/20/brookfield-and-sf-port-modify-pier-70-project-as-market-shifts/.

item.title: Correction · Historic Building 12: Building 12's lift was shown as one range that mixed the Port's…

item.title: Correction · Historic Building 12: A September 2026 accuracy check against the cited sources led…
item.description: A September 2026 accuracy check against the cited sources led to these corrections: Breadbelly B12 opened July 3, 2025 (Port minutes), not around Feb 2025 (a DataSF registration date); Standard Deviant is dated June 2025 (the June 6 date was a pre-opening announcement); Bay Padel's June 2024 opening now cites the Port's June 2025 deck; DataSF registrations for Monograph Capital, Scuderia West and Elevation Sky Park SF are no longer described as openings, and the duplicate Elevation Sky Park SF tenant entry was removed. The record now says the lift was 'nearly nine feet' per the Port's 2018 release, that the 66-year lease is what the DDA terms call for (no executed lease found), that General Catalyst's lease date is a report date, and that the Port does not name the two third-floor venture capital firms. The four D4D photographs of Building 12 and the D4D Figure 6.6.1/6.6.2 page were removed (the D4D credits them to SITELAB urban studio and Shae Rocco / Forest City, private parties, and grants no reuse licence), and unsourced claims about the old parcel and the distance to RH were removed. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-07-08 (https://sfport.com/media/10661/download?inline=); The San Francisco Standard, 2025-06-25 (https://sfstandard.com/2025/06/25/standard-deviant-brewing-pier-70-mission-kolsch/); Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, Pier 70 Project Update, 2025-06 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Pier%2070%20Update%20-%20June%202025%20v3.pdf); Port of San Francisco, news release, 2018-05-10 (https://www.sfport.com/about/news/new-life-pier-70-historic-shipyard-construction-begins-expansive-waterfront-district); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); The Real Deal, 2026-01-27 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/01/27/vc-firm-joins-pier-70-in-significant-office-lease); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Historic Building 12: The Real Deal's $237.4M figure for Brookfield's reported Phase…
item.description: The Real Deal's $237.4M figure for Brookfield's reported Phase 1 spending (The Real Deal, Oct 20, 2022: 'spent $237.4 million on its first phase, which includes infrastructure, road work and the restoration of Building 12') covers infrastructure and road work alongside the Building 12 restoration, with no Building 12-specific breakdown published, so it was never a figure for this one building. It was moved to the shared site-wide cost list as a development cost for the Pier 70 28-Acre Project Phase 1, with this record pointing to it, since the source does discuss Building 12's restoration as part of what the figure covers. Source: https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2022/10/20/brookfield-and-sf-port-modify-pier-70-project-as-market-shifts/.

item.title: Added · Historic Building 12: Standard Deviant Brewing, open at 1070 Maryland St (Building 12)…
item.description: Standard Deviant Brewing, open at 1070 Maryland St (Building 12) since June 2025, had been missing and was added, confirmed via press coverage. It has no DataSF Registered Business Location record under any name at that address as of the 2026-09-22 data, a real gap in DataSF's own dataset, so a scan of business registrations alone will keep missing open, press-covered tenants that haven't registered, and press checks remain necessary. The SF Chronicle (June 4, 2025) announced the taproom would open on Friday, June 6; the SF Standard (June 25, 2025) reported it 'less than two weeks in', so the exact opening day is not confirmed and this entry dates it to June 2025. Source: https://sfstandard.com/2025/06/25/standard-deviant-brewing-pier-70-mission-kolsch/.

item.title: Added · Historic Building 12: Breadbelly opened its second location, Breadbelly B12, in Pier 70's…
item.description: Breadbelly opened its second location, Breadbelly B12, in Pier 70's Building 12 on July 3, 2025 (Port Commission minutes, July 8, 2025), and has moved all bread and pastry production there (SF Chronicle, June 30, 2025). A DataSF business registration for Breadbelly B12 at 1070 Maryland St Ste 122 shows a location start date of Feb 24, 2025; that is a registration, not the opening. This entry previously said around February 2025 and gave a 3,500 sq ft size that no source states. Source: https://sfport.com/media/10661/download?inline=.

item.title: Added · Historic Building 12: Bay Padel opened in Pier 70's Building 12 in June 2024 (Port and…
item.description: Bay Padel opened in Pier 70's Building 12 in June 2024 (Port and Brookfield June 2025 project update, p.14: 'June 2024 - Opened Bay Padel'); DataSF business registrations list Bay Padel LLC at 1070 Maryland St Ste 140 from June 6, 2024. The club's own page describes indoor padel courts and lists 11 outdoor courts as coming soon. This entry previously cited only the club's page, which gives no opening date or suite, and described a gear boutique, snack bar and indoor pickleball that the page does not support. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Pier%2070%20Update%20-%20June%202025%20v3.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Historic Building 12: Building 12's source citation pointed at a private copy of the…
item.description: Building 12's source citation pointed at a private copy of the status table that readers cannot open. It was repointed to the same file in the public data repository (https://github.com/pierandpoint/record/blob/main/data/status.csv). That URL returned HTTP 403 when checked on 2026-09-29, so a reader cannot currently open it. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.description: Historic Building 12 moved to its real parcel at 1070 Maryland St (address per Brookfield's Pier 70 page and DBI permit M1230687). item.title: Milestone · Historic Building 12: Building 12 itself lifted (10 ft per the architect, 12… (~2020)
item.description: Building 12 itself lifted (10 ft per the architect, 12 ft per ENR and the contractor) on more than 200 hydraulic jacks over four weeks; the lift was ending in December 2020 (Perkins&Will, December 10, 2020: "This week, the original structure ... will be set down on new precisely constructed columns"). Building 15's own move is the separate October 2018 entry above; no source read dates a Building 15 lift to 2020 (~2020). Source: Plant Construction Company (contractor's claim); Perkins&Will (architect's claim), 2020-12-10; Engineering News-Record, 2022-10-17.
item.source: Plant Construction Company (contractor's claim); Perkins&Will (architect's claim), 2020-12-10; Engineering News-Record, 2022-10-17

item.title: Milestone · Historic Building 12: Building 15 is lifted in one piece and moved… (Oct 24, 2018)
item.description: Building 15 is lifted in one piece and moved about 200 feet (NBC Bay Area, published October 24, 2018: "workers stripped it down to its frame, lifted it in one piece and wheeled it about 200 feet away Wednesday"). This was the move away from its original site; the Port's June 2025 deck puts the later lift into its permanent position over the newly built 22nd Street somewhere in its 2018-2020 infrastructure window, with no year stated (Oct 24, 2018). Source: NBC Bay Area, 2018-10-24; Plant Construction Company (contractor's claim); Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06.
item.source: NBC Bay Area, 2018-10-24; Plant Construction Company (contractor's claim); Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06

item.title: Milestone · Historic Building 12: Phase 1 groundbreaking ceremony for the 28-acre… (May 10, 2018)
item.description: Phase 1 groundbreaking ceremony for the 28-acre project (the Port release: "celebrated the start of construction on an expansive 28-acre waterfront neighborhood"); it describes Building 12 as a 120,000 sq ft historic structure that Forest City "will be elevating ... nearly nine feet" for sea-level-rise protection, and does not say work on Building 12 itself had begun (May 10, 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2018-05-10.

item.title: Milestone · Historic Building 12: DDA terms approved: a vertical developer… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: DDA terms approved: a vertical developer affiliate must take a 66-year lease of Building 12 within a year after completion of the public improvements for Parcel E2, base rent $1/year, participation rent 3.5% of modified gross income from year 31 after TCO, and seek historic tax credits (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
